content.title: 2024 Kentucky Derby News | KentuckyDerby.com
content.text: Derby News February 23, 2026 Napoleon Solo stretches out in Fountain of Youth Napoleon Solo will have his two-turn capabilities tested off the bat in his three-year-old bow Saturday in the $425,000 Fountain of Youth (G2). Features February 23, 2026 Your Guide to 2026 Derby Week Events Get ready for an unforgettable Derby Week! From Opening Day to Thurby, Oaks Day, and the 152nd Kentucky Derby, discover key event times and how to join the celebration at Churchill Downs. Derby News February 23, 2026 Balboa targeted by Iron Honor in Gotham Iron Honor, a key race winner on debut at Aqueduct on Dec. 13, is the potential horse to beat Saturday in the $300,000 Gotham (G3). Derby News February 23, 2026 Hidden Force favored to extend Appleby dominance at Kempton The Euro/Mideast Road returns to a European venue Wednesday at Kempton, where Godolphin’s Hidden Force rates as the prohibitive odds-on favorite against just three rivals. Horse Profile February 23, 2026 Kentucky Derby Horse Profile: Great White The three-year-old gelding named Great White took one step closer to earning a spot in the Kentucky Derby starting gate after recording a neck victory in the $174,825 John Battaglia Memorial S. at Turfway Park on Feb. 21. Derby News February 22, 2026 Lucky Kid gives Godolphin another Japan Road victory in Hyacinth Godolphin’s homebred Lucky Kid took over the top spot on the Japan Road leaderboard when scoring a 22.50-1 upset in Sunday’s Hyacinth S. at Tokyo. Derby News February 21, 2026 Great White pulls 15-1 upset in $174,835 John Battaglia Memorial Great White made a bold three-wide move around the far turn and held off a late charge from Fulleffort to win Saturday night’s 44th running of the $174,835 John Battaglia Memorial at Turfway Park. Oaks News February 20, 2026 Resplendence joins Road to Kentucky Oaks with Cincinnati Trophy victory Bonne Chance Farm’s Resplendence went gate-to-wire for an 11-1 upset victory in Friday night’s 44th running of the $174,800 Cincinnati Trophy at Turfway Park Racing & Gaming. Derby News February 20, 2026 Brotherly Love rallies in Dubai Road to Kentucky Derby; Labwah romps in UAE Oaks Brotherly Love won the Dubai Road to the Kentucky Derby S. after the dramatic scratch of Salloom, and the filly Labwah impressed in the UAE Oaks (G3). Derby News February 19, 2026 Japan Road: Arcadia Cafe seeks brotherly hat-trick in Hyacinth The Japan Road resumes late Saturday night (12:25 a.m. ET) with the Hyacinth S., where Triple Crown nominee Arcadia Cafe will try to emulate his half-brothers by winning the metric mile affair.
